position_sizing.conditional_logic: When MM is negative, absolute value is used as fixed lot size; when positive, it represents the share of deposit per deal

custom_logic_notes: EA implements 4 entry modes selectable via AlgMode enum: (1) 'breakdown' - MACD histogram crosses zero line; (2) 'MACDtwist' - MACD histogram changes direction (Value[0]>Value[1] after Value[1]<Value[2] for buy); (3) 'SIGNALtwist' - Signal line (buffer 2) changes direction; (4) 'MACDdisposition' - MACD histogram crosses signal line. Default mode is MACDdisposition. The NonLagDot variant is a zero-lag smoothing technique applied to the MACD calculation, replacing standard MAs with NonLagDot MAs. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose boolean gates independently control entry and exit permissions. SignalBar=1 means signals are read from the previous closed bar (not current forming bar). Recount flag triggers signal recalculation if CopyBuffer fails.
python_conversion_notes: The custom ColorNonLagDotMACD indicator must be reimplemented in Python. NonLagDot is a zero-lag moving average - need to find its algorithm (likely uses extrapolation of linear regression or similar zero-lag technique). The MACD is then NonLagDot(fast_period) - NonLagDot(slow_period), with a signal line of NonLagDotMA(signal_period) applied to the MACD. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, CIsNewBar, LoadHistory, GlobalVariableDel_) handle order management and must be reimplemented as standard market order logic with SL/TP. The 4 entry modes are straightforward conditional logic. Position sizing with negative MM=lot size is a simple conditional. SignalBar=1 means always use previous bar's values for signal generation.
